answer_1.quote: We use text to vector-graphics (T2VG) generation to test an LLM's ability to generate vector graphics code conditioned on a text prompt.

answer_2.quote: we use CLIP Score and Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) to evaluate the quality of the LLM generated vector graphics code.

answer_3.quote: For LLMs with weaker instruction-following capabilities in producing easily parsable outputs, we use GPT-4 to determine their chosen option and then assess their accuracy.
